risk_review.strongest_alternative_explanation: the after-arm RETRIEVE drop could be general provider-load luck across the two waves rather than the openalex exclusion. Counterevidence: (1) the drop's magnitude matches the measured openalex job wall within seconds on every pair (fan-out 60.16-60.27 vs job 60.15-60.27); (2) after fan-out walls (22.6-36.2s) equal the sibling max-job shape; (3) the straggler identity is mechanical — the fan-out cannot finish before a job that holds the worker pool; (4) effect is stable 6/6 with same-sign deltas. Residual risk acknowledged: same-window sibling responses could have correlated; the claim is scoped to the measured wall + job attribution, which is exactly what the durable bytes show.
